MENU_QUICK_DESC: Noma yimaphi amazwe amabili, noma iyiphi inkundla. I-centre pass ingeyakho.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Amazwe angu-8, amaqoqo amabili, ama-semi-final nowamanqamu.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Inkundla, izikhundla eziyisikhombisa nayo yonke imithetho ebizwa onompempe.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Umdlalo wangempela unamakota amane emizuzu eyi-15. Iwashi liyaqhubeka ngisho kushaywa amagoli, limiswa kuphela uma kunokulimala.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Umthetho weligi: emizuzwini emihlanu yokugcina yekota ngayinye, igoli elishaywe ku-3 m noma ngaphezulu libalwa kabili.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Abavikeli babo bephuza ukufunda amaphasi akho, futhi abavamile ukuwahlwitha.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Iqembu leklabhu elihle: bazoyithatha iphasi eyenziwe budedengu.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Iqembu lamazwe ngamazwe: lifunda umdlalo ngokushesha, kunzima ukudlula kulo.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Abangcono emhlabeni. Yonke iphasi eyenziwe ngobuvila iyahlwithwa.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: Udlala nganoma ubani onebhola, kanye nomvikeli oseduze nalo.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Iqembu: ulawula noma ubani onebhola. Isikhundla esisodwa: khetha i-bib esikrinini sasekhaya bese umdlala umdlalo wonke, njengoba kwenza umdlali.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Kuvuliwe: umdlali wakho uma emaphethelweni ezindawo isikhundla sakhe esivunyelwe ukungena kuzo. Kuvaliwe: weqa umugqa, unompempe abize i-offside.
POS_ROLE_GA: Ushaya amagoli, uphakela u-Goal Shooter futhi uqhubekela phambili engxenyeni emaphakathi.
POS_ROLE_WA: Uphakela isiyingi esemaphethelweni aso; ungowokuqala ukukhethwa ku-centre pass.
POS_ROLE_C: Uthatha i-centre pass futhi uxhumanisa ukuvikela nokuhlasela kuyo yonke inkundla.
POS_ROLE_WD: Ugada u-Wing Attack futhi uvimba iphasi engena esiyingini.
POS_ROLE_GD: Ugada u-Goal Attack, ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesiyingi.
POS_ROLE_GK: Ugada u-Goal Shooter, uvikela ukushaya futhi abambe ibhola elibuyayo.
POS_AREAS_GA: Izindawo: ingxenye emaphakathi, ingxenye yokuhlasela nesiyingi segoli.
POS_AREAS_WA: Izindawo: ingxenye emaphakathi nengxenye yokuhlasela, hhayi isiyingi.
POS_AREAS_C: Izindawo: zontathu izingxenye, hhayi isiyingi nesisodwa.
POS_AREAS_WD: Izindawo: ingxenye emaphakathi nengxenye yokuvikela, hhayi isiyingi.
POS_AREAS_GD: Izindawo: ingxenye emaphakathi, ingxenye yokuvikela nesiyingi segoli.
GFX_NOTE: Phansi kulungele amafoni ashibhile: azikho izinhlaka, isixuku esincane. Uma okuzenzakalelayo kuvuliwe, umdlalo ohamba kancane emizuzwaneni yokuqala wehla izinga ngokwawo.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Cishe amafreyimu angu-{n} ngomzuzwana, adwetshwe emancane kancane: ifoni ipholile, nebhethri lihlala isikhathi eside.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Amafreyimu angu-{n} ngomzuzwana esikrinini sakho se-{hz} Hz: kushelela, futhi kudla ibhethri kancane kunokuningi.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Wonke amafreyimu isikrini sakho se-{hz} Hz esingawakhombisa.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Hudula inkinobho ngayinye uyise lapho isithupha sakho siyithola khona. Zizohlala lapho.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Umdlalo ozimele. Amaqembu angamazwe abizwa ngamagama awo ajwayelekile; wonke amagama abadlali aqanjiwe. Awuhlobene nanoma iyiphi inhlangano ephethe, iligi noma umqhudelwano.
LICENCES_INTRO: Lo mdlalo wakhiwe ngesofthiwe yamahhala nevulekile. Amalayisensi ayo acela ukuthi kukhonjiswe lezi zaziso; zisesiNgisini, njengoba zabhalwa.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Ubude bungu-30,5 m, ububanzi bungu-15,25 m, ihlukaniswe izingxenye ezintathu. Phakathi kunesiyingi esimaphakathi esingu-0,9 m ububanzi, kuthi ekugcineni ngakunye kube nesiyingi segoli: uhhafu wesiyingi ongu-4,9 m ukusuka epalini yegoli. Iringi iphakeme ngo-3,05 m, ayinalo ibhodi.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Umdlali ngamunye ugqoka i-bib enesikhundla sakhe, futhi angangena kuphela ezindaweni zesikhundla sakhe. Iqembu liqamba abadlali abafika kweshumi nambili; ukushintsha kwenziwa ngamakhefu, ngemva kwegoli uma kucelwa, nangenxa yokulimala.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Ngu-Goal Shooter no-Goal Attack kuphela abangashaya igoli, futhi kuphela besesiyingini segoli. Ibhola kufanele lidlule ngokuphelele eringini. Ukushaya okuphume ezandleni zakhe ngaphambi kokuba kushaywe impempe kuyabalwa.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Ikota ngayinye iqala nge-centre pass, kanjalo nomdlalo ngemva kwegoli ngalinye. Amaqembu ayashintshana, noma ngubani oshaye igoli. U-Centre umi esiyingini esimaphakathi; abanye balinda ezingxenyeni zabo zegoli kuze kushaywe impempe, futhi iphasi kufanele ibanjwe engxenyeni emaphakathi.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Amakota amane emizuzu eyi-15, nemizuzu emine phakathi kwekota yokuqala neyesibili, nephakathi kweyesithathu neyesine, nemizuzu eyishumi nambili ngekhefu eliphakathi. Amaqembu ashintsha izinhlangothi ikota ngayinye.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Uma umdlalo kumele ube nowinile kodwa amaqembu alingana: izingxenye ezimbili ezifika emizuzwini eyisikhombisa, nomzuzu owodwa phakathi kwazo, bese kudlalwa kuze kube yilapho iqembu elilodwa lihola ngamagoli amabili.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Uma ephethe ibhola akavunyelwe ukugijima. Unyawo ehlela ngalo yilona lwakhe lokwehlela: angathatha isinyathelo ngolunye unyawo futhi azungeze kulo, kodwa uma eseluphakamisile, kufanele adlulise noma ashaye ngaphambi kokuba luthinte phansi futhi. Iphasi yamahhala eqenjini eliphikisayo.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Kufanele adlulise noma ashaye kungakapheli imizuzwana emi-3 ebambe ibhola. Ukubamba isikhathi eside: iphasi yamahhala.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Umvikeli ozama ukuvimba noma ukuthatha ibhola kufanele eme okungenani ku-0,9 m ukusuka onyaweni lokwehlela lomdlali onebhola. Uma esondele ngaphezu kwalokho, kuwukuvimba: iphasi yesijeziso.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Akukho ukuthintana okuphazamisa umdlalo wembangi: ukusunduza, ukubamba, ukushaya ibhola liphume ezandleni zakhe, noma ukungamniki isikhala sokwehla umdlali othole ibhola. Iphasi yesijeziso.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Umdlali ongena endaweni isikhundla sakhe esingavunyelwe ukungena kuyo, enebhola noma engenalo, use-offside. Imigqa iyingxenye yezindawo ezizungezwe yiyo. Iphasi yamahhala.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Ibhola alivunyelwe ukujikijelwa ngaphezu kwengxenye yonke ngaphandle kokuthi umdlali okuleyo ngxenye alibambe noma alithinte. Iphasi yamahhala.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Kufanele kube nesikhala sokuthi imbangi ihlwithe ibhola phakathi komjikijeli nombambi. Iphasi yamahhala.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Ibhola eliwela ngaphandle kwenkundla linikezwa iqembu elingalithintanga lokugcina: i-throw-in kusuka lapho lieqe khona umugqa, eyenziwa kungakapheli imizuzwana emithathu.
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Iphasi yamahhala yenziwa lapho iphutha lenzeke khona, yinoma yimuphi umdlali ovunyelwe ukuba lapho. Ephasini yesijeziso, umdlali ojeziswayo umi eceleni komjikijeli, engadlali, kuze kudedelwe ibhola. Esiyingini segoli, isijeziso singaba yiphasi noma ukushaya.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Unompempe uvumela umdlalo uqhubeke uma ukuwumisa kungalimaza iqembu elonelwe: isibonelo, umshayi osezoshaya. Umemezela inzuzo kanye nephutha.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Ngokudlala okuphindaphindwayo noma okuyingozi, unompempe angaxwayisa umdlali, amumise imizuzu emibili yesikhathi sokudlala, noma amkhiphe enkundleni. Kusukela ngo-2024 akusekho i-toss-up: uma abadlali ababili benza iphutha ngasikhathi sinye, iqembu obeligcine ukuba nebhola liyaligcina.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Amanye amaligi adlala ngezinguquko. Lo mdlalo unikeza i-Double Zone: emizuzwini emihlanu yokugcina yekota ngayinye, igoli elishaywe ku-3 m noma ngaphezulu ukusuka epalini libalwa kabili.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Isithupha sakho sobunxele noma kuphi ngakwesobunxele sesikrini siyijoystick: sigijimisa umdlali wakho (iringi eluhlaza okukhanyayo). Gijimela esikhaleni ukuze ukhululeke uthole iphasi.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Uma ephethe ibhola akakwazi ukugijima. Cindezela induku ubhekise kozakwenu ukuze umkhethe (iringi ikhombisa ukuthi ngubani), bese uthinta DLULISA ukuze kube iphasi yesifuba noma yehlombe, noma PHEZULU ukuze udlule phezu komvikeli. Iringi engaphezu kwebhola yimizuzwana yakho emithathu.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: SHAYA iyavela uma u-Goal Shooter noma u-Goal Attack wakho enebhola esiyingini. Eduze kuqinisekile kakhulu; ingalo yomvikeli phezu kwebhola yenza kube nzima.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: VIKELA iphakamisa izingalo zakho phezu kwebhola. Bheka iringi ezungeze unyawo lwakhe lokwehlela: okuluhlaza kuvumelekile, okubomvu kusondele ngaphezu kuka-0,9 m futhi unompempe uzobiza ukuvimba.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: HLWITHA igxumela iphasi esemoyeni uma ungayifinyelela ngesikhathi. Uma ugxumela umdlali ophethe ibhola, kuwukuthintana.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Uma udlala njengeqembu, ulawula noma ubani onebhola, futhi SHINTSHA ikuyisa kumvikeli oseduze nalo. Khetha i-bib esikrinini sasekhaya ukuze udlale isikhundla esisodwa umdlalo wonke.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD noma imicibisholo ukuze unyakaze, Space yenkinobho yokuqala, J no-K ezinye, Esc ukumisa okwesikhashana.
INTERVAL_NOTE: Ikhefu lithatha imizuzu engu-{min}; Qhubeka iqala {next} manje.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Thepha isikhundla ukuze ungenise umdlali olandelayo ebhentshini odlala kuso.
CUP_ABOUT: Amazwe ayisishiyagalombili aseduze nelakho ohlwini lwamazinga lomhlaba, emaqoqweni amabili amazwe amane. Amabili aphezulu eqoqo ngalinye adlulela kuma-semi-final; bese kuba owamanqamu nomdlalo wethusi. Amaphuzu amabili ngokuwina, elilodwa ngokulingana; uma kulingene kunqunywa ngephesenti lamagoli.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Dlala umdlalo bese amarekhodi akho aqala lapha.
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: Umthetho weligi: iqembu ngalinye lingacela ama-time-out amabili emizuzwana engu-90 engxenyeni ngayinye, ngemva kwegoli. Elakho lisemenyu yokumisa.
ROLLING_NOTE: Umthetho weligi: shintsha iqembu noma nini kumenyu yokumisa, hhayi ngamakhefu kuphela.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: Imizuzwana engu-90, isikhathi simisiwe. Shintsha iqembu manje; Qhubeka uma usulungile.
INJURY_NOTE: Umdlali weqembu {team} ulimele. Iqembu linemizuzwana engu-30 ukumsiza aphume enkundleni; womabili amaqembu angashintsha. Qhubeka uma usulungile.
UMP_FEWER_NOTE: Abanye abadlali benza ingxenye yamaphutha ajwayelekile.
UMP_STANDARD_NOTE: Cishe ingxenye yesithathu yamaphutha omdlalo wezingcweti, ukuze umdlalo ugeleze.
UMP_REAL_NOTE: Amaphutha amaningi njengasemdlalweni wezingcweti: cishe angu-50 iqembu ngalinye emizuzwini engu-60.
COACH_TIPS_NOTE: Izeluleko ezimfushane emdlalweni, ngasinye okokuqala lapho usidinga. Ziyavaleka ngemva komdlalo wakho wokuqala ophelele.
COACH_MOVE: Hamba ngenduku engakwesobunxele. Udlala lowo oneringi eluhlaza okukhanyayo; izinhlamvu eku-bib yakhe zisho lapho angaya khona.
COACH_PASS: Unebhola: awuvunyelwe ukugijima nalo, futhi kufanele udlulise kungakapheli imizuzwana emi-3. Thepha {pass} ukuphonsa eringini enamachashaza, noma uqale ukhombe othile ngenduku.
COACH_SHOOT: Usesiyingini segoli: thepha {shoot}. Uma useduze nepali, ukushaya kuqiniseka kakhulu.
COACH_FOOTWORK: Uphethe ibhola umile: induku iyakujikisa kuphela. {lob} intantisa ibhola phezu komvikeli omude.
COACH_DEFEND: Banebhola. Gijimela umdlali umqaphe. {defend} iphakamisa izingalo zakho, kodwa hlala ku-0,9 m: iringi iba bomvu uma usondele kakhulu.
COACH_INTERCEPT: Iphasi isemoyeni: thepha {intercept} ukuyigxumela. {switch} ikuyisa kozakwenu oseduze nebhola.
COACH_WHISTLE: Impempe: isibhengezo esingaphezulu sisho ukuthi kungani, nokuthi yiliphi iqembu elinebhola manje.
COACH_AREAS: Isikhundla ngasinye sinezindawo zaso enkundleni: uma uphuma kuzo kuyi-offside. Indlela yokudlala inamamephu.
MENU_LEAGUE_DESC: Amaklabhu angu-8, imizuliswano engu-7, bese kuba eyamanqamu.
LEAGUE_ABOUT: Amaklabhu ayisishiyagalombili ase-Australia, eNew Zealand, eNgilandi naseNingizimu Afrika adlalana kanye. Amane aphezulu aya emidlalweni yamanqamu: owokuqala udlala nowesine, owesibili nowesithathu, bese abawinile behlangana kowamanqamu omkhulu. Amaphuzu amabili ngokuwina, elilodwa ngokulingana; uma kulingene kunqunywa ngephesenti lamagoli.
LEAGUE_OUT: Iklabhu yakho ayingenanga emidlalweni yamanqamu. Iyaqhubeka ngaphandle kwakho.
